details:
This update for 389-ds fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-11770: pre-auth LDAP filter injection in CleanAllRUV status check (bsc#1273133).
- CVE-2026-18355: heap buffer overflow in the SASL I/O layer allows a remote authenticated attacker to cause a denial of
  service or potentially achieve remote code execution (bsc#1279864).
- CVE-2026-18453: pre-authentication NULL pointer dereference via paged results and
  USE_ONE_BACKEND control in op_shared_search (bsc#1279572).
- CVE-2026-18922: stale identity carried in a Cyrus SASL auxiliary property during SASL PLAIN authentication allows
  unauthenticated attackers to achieve privilege escalation to Directory Manager (bsc#1279865).
- CVE-2026-19843: unescaped LDAP DN in Cockpit 389 Console LDAP editor allows an LDAP user with delegated privileges to
  execute shell commands with root privileges on the directory server host (bsc#1279866).
- CVE-2026-76560: incorrect matching in the SELFDN ACI bind-rule evaluator allows an anonymous LDAP client to bypass
  access controls on directory entries containing empty SELFDN attributes (bsc#1279867).
- CVE-2026-86344: incomplete LDAP messages sent in rapid succession can cause worker thread exhaustion (bsc#1284028).
- CVE-2026-86345: smuggled plaintext commands sent alongside StartTLS requests can cause response forgery and
  authentication bypasses (bsc#1284034).
  
Update to version 2.2.11~git12.1e612cde2:
 
 * Issue 7919 - CVE-2026-86344 - Fix worker pool exhaustion via partial LDAP messages (DoS)
 * Issue 7921 - Fix StartTLS plaintext buffer handling (#7922) (#7947)
  
Update to version 2.2.11~git10.1f26fcebd:
 
 * Issue 7912 - dsidm role create-filtered ignores --nsrolefilter and forces an interactive prompt (#7913)
 * Issue 7908 - dsctl cockpit open-firewall --zone passes a malformed argument (#7909)
 * Issue 7848 - Reject incomplete MD5 and GOST-YESCRYPT hashes (#7849)
 * Issue 7837 - importing ldif with entry with long attribute name and subtype causes stack-buffer-overflow (#7838)
 * Issue 6270 - heap-use-after-free with pwp dictionary path (#7791)
 * Issue 7611 - PBKDF2 password verification should reject invalid iteration counts (#7632) (#7854)
 * iadvisories/GHSA-rgxx-hcc4-x3h4 / heap-buffer-overflow in rdn_av_swap (#7826)
 * Migrate pwdchan to base64 0.23 Engine API
 * Update rust-dependencies

Update to version 2.2.11~git1.98ee3aac7:
 
 * Issue 7757 - stack-buffer-overflow caused by slapi_attr_init_syntax() (#7759)

 * Security fix for CVE-2026-18453

 * Issue 7595 - Remove the nightly dedup gate and fix dispatched test runs

 * Issue 1704 - Include stdbool.h in slapi headers on 2.4 (#7768)

 * Issue 4701 - Fix UAF when excluding attrs from retro changelog (#7730)
 * Issue 7723 - Range search returns an empty result when its start key is removed (#7724)
 * Issue 7735 - Heap overflow when parsing objectclass superior (#7736)
 * Issue 7733 - Typo about nsuniqueid in tombstone_to_conflict (#7734)
 * Issue 7707 - lib389: set nsDS5ReplicaBindDNGroup before ensure_agreement() in join_supplier/hub/consumer (#7708)
